summary.en: The one hand-drawn emphasis: a smooth vermilion underline, ellipse or brace drawn in one go and never boiling; at most four a film.
summary.zh: 唯一的手画强调：一笔画成的朱红下划线、椭圆或大括号，画完不再抖；一部片至多四处。

fits: The sentence or group the viewer must look at: a rule, a decision, what a figure spans.
notFor: Decoration; more than four places a film.

intent.en: Point like a person at the one thing that matters, so the viewer knows where to look.
intent.zh: 像人用手指一样指向那一件要紧的事，让观众知道看哪里。

content.en: A target already on screen (a line of text or a group) and the kind: underline, circle or brace.
content.zh: 画面上已有的目标（一行字或一组东西）和种类：下划线、圈或大括号。

fits.zh: 观众必须看的那句话或那一组：一条规矩、一个决定、一个数字涵盖的范围。

en: At most four a film; a fifth makes none of them stand out.
Draw it once and keep it still; a boiling line reads as noise.
zh: 一部片至多四处，第五处会让所有标记都不突出。
一笔画成后静止；抖动的线像噪声。

overlaps.note: a marker under one word of a title (keynote); here a smooth vermilion stroke whose geometry is measured from the target
a grease-pencil loop on a contact sheet (keynote)
